tools: Apache Maven 3.9.x (the repository has no Maven wrapper; verified with 3.9.12)
commands: cd src && MAVEN_OPTS=-Xmx2g mvn -B -Dmaven.test.skip=true -DskipTests -pl activemq-client -am package
notes: Builds activemq-client (project version 6.2.0-SNAPSHOT) with the reactor of the root pom (activemq-parent) and activemq-client; the build generates the selector parser from the commit's own grammar (activemq-client/src/main/grammar/SelectorParser.jj, javacc-maven-plugin). -Dmaven.test.skip=true -DskipTests: tests are neither compiled nor run. The runtime dependencies of activemq-client at this commit (slf4j-api 2.0.16, jakarta.jms-api 3.1.0, hawtbuf 1.11) are declared in the fixture pom. Fixed: activemq-client 6.1.6 (first patched 6.x release); the evaluation's fixed class path also carries the Central jars of hawtbuf, jakarta.jms-api, slf4j-api and slf4j-simple, so drop covers them too.
